title: Aoyagi Toya — What Happened To What I Felt〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: What Happened To What I Felt（2★）

rows.Line: Shibuya Park
Hey, what did I say about not throwing the ball toward the street...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? That sounds like... Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Ah, Toya, perfect!
Mind picking up that ball there for me?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was playing catch with these kids just now, but they aren't very good at throwing the ball and can't seem to get it to go straight.

rows.Speaker: Boy A
rows.Line:
That's not fair.
You're a terrible teacher.

rows.Speaker: Boy B
rows.Line: Yeah, what he said!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, but... Weren't you the ones who asked me to teach you while I was warming up for singing practice because you thought I was good at baseball?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what's going on exactly, but you just need me to toss you this ball, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... How do I actually grip a baseball...? There's also quite a way between us, Tono, so I may need to throw this fairly hard...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Alright...
Tono, here it comes.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Boy A
rows.Line: Hey, he was supposed to throw it back to us. Why'd he spike it into the ground?

rows.Speaker: Boy B
rows.Line: No idea.

rows.Speaker: Boy A
rows.Line: See you later, noobs!

rows.Speaker: Boy B
rows.Line: Get better at throwing and teaching for next time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I apologize for making you go through that, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Also, I didn't realize how unathletic you were...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, ball sports in particular are my Achilles' heel since I haven't really played any before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, Tono, did you know those kids from before?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, we met for the first time here just now. I believe they're local residents of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It's nice that they get to grow up in a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: From the time they're born, they get to live life while being exposed to all things related to music.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: In that respect, your friend, An, comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Akito's very envious of her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
Do you like this city, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I've been discussing with Akito and the others about what it means to “take a look at this city”, and we began wondering if those sorts of feelings were related in any way.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
Do I like this city...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I honestly can't say...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So much has happened while I've been here.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Like what I saw that night with Soma.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Or working on my singing every day like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And things that I'd taken for granted but were taken away from me all of the sudden... So much has happened.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, if anything, I should be apologizing. I'm sorry about the somber tone.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I feel that it was also necessary for me to look back upon the past since this city has so much to do with it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Most importantly, I was overseas and not actually here for quite some time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To work on your singing, yes?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. However, there was likely also a part of me that didn't want to be here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I were in his shoes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm not sure I could keep singing here in this city with Akito absent...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And despite all that, Tono, you decided to return.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. It was also nice to see that not much had changed when I did.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I myself had changed a lot...because I needed to... And a part of me was uncomfortable with the fact that not much had changed around here.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: When Taiga told me to “take a look at this city”, it honestly felt like he saw right through that and was telling me to get a grip on reality.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
What about you, Toya?
Do you like this city?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I opened up quite a bit to you, so would you mind doing the same for me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I like this city.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It became a place where I could belong when I had nowhere else to go, including my own home. I was even able to meet a partner I could share the same dream with.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This city and the people I've met here have accepted me when I had nothing because I have one thing in common with them... A love for music.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito and the others even began to accept me as a person as I sang with them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, this city means everything to me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I think I know what you mean by feeling accepted by others.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I... We were the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Toya? And Tono...?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I was hoping that we could warm up together since we'd be practicing with everyone later...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Me too... We've been chatting for quite a while now, so let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm glad we could talk, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What exactly were you two talking about just now...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's start warming up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, don't just ignore me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe...
